messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] autoscale.throttle_events >= 100/min (us-west) — queue_depth spiking + elevated tokens/sec. Triggered 1842012345. paging: @maria_sre @alex_oncall

maria_sre: seeing a 3x increase in queue depth across inference-pool-usw-1. Throttles ~120/min on 4 hosts. We should assess customer impact first.

alex_oncall: on it. I'm pulling recent dashboards. Can someone confirm if this is related to the KV-cache rollout earlier?

jordan_platform: KV cache rollout completed at 1842011200, but only to a subset. Looks unrelated from the rollout logs.

sam_ml: customers reporting rate-limits in support slack — multiple teams. I'll mark as P1 for now and escalate to support.

maria_sre: mitigation idea: temporarily bump dedicated pool burst to +20% and lower autoscale trigger threshold for tokens/sec to reduce throttle events. Anyone opposed?

alex_oncall: +1 to temporary burst. Executing now.

alex_oncall: run: ```redwoodctl capacity adjust --pool inference-pool-usw-1 --burst 20% --reason "incident 1842012345"```

incident-bot: Deploy started: capacity change request submitted by alex_oncall. CI/CD task 5872.

ops_liz: deployed burst change, hosts accepted, traffic draining to new nodes. queue_depth down ~15% in last 30s.

maria_sre: good. We still have alert noise — throttles keep flipping. We should debounce the alert (increase evaluation window) so on-call doesn't get paged for transient spikes.

jordan_platform: Agreed. Current rule: eval 1m for autoscale.throttle_events >= 50. Proposal: change to eval 3m and add a rate-of-change guard: and increase to >= 75. That reduces noise but still catches sustained surges.

alex_oncall: ok to apply as emergency alert tweak. Please post diff and I'll approve.

jordan_platform: patch for Datadog/Prometheus rule: ```yaml
- alert: HighThrottleEvents
- expr: autoscale_throttle_events{region=\"us-west\"} >= 50
- for: 1m
+ alert: HighThrottleEvents
+ expr: avg_over_time(autoscale_throttle_events{region=\"us-west\"}[3m]) >= 75
+ for: 3m
```

maria_sre: also adding a mute rule for on-call rotations to avoid paging during the first 2 minutes after a handoff — we've seen floods during handoffs.

alex_oncall: approved. jordan, can you push change with short doc in runbook? I'll ack after CI passes.

jordan_platform: pushing now. CI green. Alert rule updated at 1842012360.

incident-bot: [NOTICE] Alert rule updated by jordan_platform at 1842012360 — HighThrottleEvents now uses 3m avg.

ops_liz: after burst + alert debounce, throttles down to ~18/min, queue_depth trending to normal. Customer reports trickling in as resolved.

sam_ml: filing customer-impact note in the incident board: affected customers: 4 enterprise tenants, degraded tail latency and some 429s. No data loss.

maria_sre: action items post-incident: (1) add dashboard panel for sustained tokens/sec 3m avg, (2) add runbook step to temporarily increase pool burst, (3) evaluate autoscale policy for prefix-heavy workloads, (4) postmortem within 48h.

alex_oncall: assigning items: jordan -> dashboard & alert diff; sam_ml -> customer-impact summary; ops_liz -> runbook burst step; maria_sre -> postmortem owner.

jordan_platform: I'll create the dashboard tile: tokens/sec 3m avg + replica count + throttle events, and add graph annotations for the burst change. ETA 2h.

sam_ml: I'll work with support to collect logs and sample prompts that hit throttles for quality/regression checks.

maria_sre: quick note on thresholds: tokens/sec 99th has been creeping up over last month. We should look at autoscale headroom margins and whether our smallest step size is too coarse. Prefer to discuss in follow-up.

ops_liz: runbook update pushed: snippet below. ```
# Emergency burst bump
- who: on-call
- command: redwoodctl capacity adjust --pool <pool> --burst <percent>
- rollback: monitor queue_depth for 5m, reduce burst after stabilization
- notify: #incidents, #support
```

alex_oncall: nice. I'll close the page once dashboards confirm stabilization. Current status: queue_depth ~ baseline, throttles < 20/min, customers notified.

incident-bot: [RESOLVED] Alert cleared at 1842012380. Duration 35s.

maria_sre: thanks team. We'll follow up with the postmortem doc and implement the alert tuning and dashboard changes.

sam_ml: tagging stakeholders: @product, @solutions-eng so customers hear what's next. :memo:
